CustomField.description: A SHA-256 hash of the entry's Context, Severity and Message, plus for an exception its type and first stack line (line number included), so a repeat of the same failure finds the row it is counted on (R-E7). Marked External ID only so the platform indexes it; it is not unique.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Used by BarnCRM to group repeats of the same error.
CustomField.label: Occurrence Key
